from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 12:00 2022 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 30 June - 03 July 2022 Technical Delegate's Report Wednesday night team personnel of the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team and Haas F1 Team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the thirteen hour period which commenced at 19:00 on 29 June, fourtytwo hours before the scheduled start time of P1 and ends twentynine hours before the scheduled start time of P1 at 08:00 on 30 June. This was the second of the eight individual exceptions permitted for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team and Haas F1 Team during the 2022 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. Last night team personnel of the Scuderia Ferrari team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the fourteen hour period which commenced at 19:00 on 30 June, eighteen hours before the scheduled start time of P1 and ends four hours before the scheduled start time of P1 at 09:00 on 01 July. This was the first of the six individual exceptions permitted for the Scuderia Ferrari team during the 2022 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
